meta.title: Real fit-line clothing (maternity, petite, tall, plus/extended sizes): US, GB, IE, CA, MX
meta.priceBasis: price = regular (pre-markdown) price as listed by the retailer on its own site for that market: US and CA before sales tax/GST/HST/PST; GB, IE and MX including VAT/IVA. salePrice records a markdown seen on 2026-10-04, else null.
meta.confirmedMeaning: true = read on the product page itself or the JSON the page loads; false = category listing or search-engine snippet
meta.fitLinesMeaning: fitLines lists every fit line the product is sold in: maternity, petite, tall, plus (plus = plus/curve/extended sizes). A product sold in several lines is one entry.

Gap and Banana Republic sell no named plus line; Old Navy's plus is the same style sized to 4X/30 (fitNote says so).

Target (Isabel Maternity, Ava & Viv): category and product pages are client-rendered shells and the redsky product API returns a PerimeterX captcha; no prices could be read. target.com product page for "Over Belly 90's Straight Maternity Jeans - Isabel Maternity by Ingrid & Isabel" (A-88541420) exists per search, but no price/size data was readable. Not added.
A Pea in the Pod (apeainthepod.com): Shopify storefront shows only a banner and a form; products.json and /collections/all/products.json return no products. No products currently sold online.

No USD prices read, so no US products added (search snippets show USD pricing exists, e.g. $49-$52 trousers, but nothing verifiable per product). Men's tall not covered.

Lane Bryant: product JSON for 17 products read before PerimeterX began blocking (PX-ABR); remaining Lane Bryant items are from the Petite Shop listing page saved earlier (confirmed:false). Lane Bryant also sells "Long" inseams but does not call them Tall, so no tall fit line was assigned.
Lane Bryant stores: directory lists Brooklyn (NYC) and Northridge (City of Los Angeles); Connecticut store is North Haven, not New Haven.

Madewell petite listing showed jeans only; non-denim petite filters returned no results. Product pages (sizes, fabric) not read: madewell.com blocks curl (Akamai 403).

J.Crew: product data is client-rendered; items come from fit-filtered category listings via fetch (colours may be abridged, sizes not shown). J.Crew sweaters returned zero Tall results. Stores: New Haven 29 Broadway (store 614), LA Century City and The Grove, NYC.
